shipped_rows.title_o: An umbrella review of the benefits and risks associated with youths’ interactions with electronic screens
shipped_rows.authors_o: Sanders; Noetel; Parker; Del Pozo Cruz; Biddle; Ronto; Hulteen; Parker; Thomas; De Cocker; Salmon; Hesketh; Weeks; Arnott; Devine; Vasconcellos; Pagano; Sherson; Conigrave; Lonsdale
shipped_rows.outcome_quote: Computational: This report found no coding, mathematical, data, or reporting errors, however, and the materials were expertly prepared and transparent. || Robustness: This analysis found publication bias reduced the effect size in three of the eight meta-analyses to such a degree that these findings failed to replicate.
